verdict.rationale: Clerky is a legal-formation and paperwork SaaS, not an AI assistant or agent host, so acting as an MCP client that consumes external MCP servers' tools is outside its product role. The evidence shows only the opposite role: Clerky publishes its own remote MCP server (mcp.clerky.com) for Claude and ChatGPT to connect to. That server-side capability does not make the client-side axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
